observation.visible_scene: A close, static view of an outdoor campfire built from a pile of dry twigs and small branches laid in a criss-cross/teepee arrangement on pale sandy ground. Bright yellow-orange-white flames rise from and around the sticks for the whole excerpt.
visible_changes: The flames continuously flicker and deform: their height, outline, and internal structure change from frame to frame, with tongues of fire curling, splitting, and shifting slightly left and right.
The brightness and color balance of the flame body fluctuate—some frames show a broad white-hot core, others more separated orange licks—while the overall fire remains vigorously burning.

The sticks and the ground do not translate or collapse; their positions and orientations stay fixed relative to the frame edges, so all visible motion is in the flame itself, not in the fuel or the camera.
outside_clip_unknowns: How the fire was ignited and what fuel or arrangement existed before this segment.
Whether the fire will grow, die down, or the sticks will shift after the last frame.
The exact material of the sticks and the surrounding environment beyond the cropped view.
uncertain_details: The camera appears stationary, but very small handheld drift cannot be fully ruled out from the frames.
Whether the fire is on a slow overall upward or downward trend across the excerpt is not clearly supported; it looks roughly steady.
